name: Trials of Troubleshooters: Out of the Friend Zone
source:
Kevin Datana has been Coriander(Cori)'s partner since they met in training-- Five years ago. In that time, he's kept a professional distance from her. The two have just come back from a long mission, and finally, it's all come to a head- he's got to confess. But can he? Or is he too far into the Friend Zone to ever climb out? He's got one day out to find out. An entertaining supporting cast is there to help or hinder him-- Succeed or fail, his fate is in YOUR hands. 


[From[url=http://www.renai.us/game/totootfz.shtml] Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
凱文．達塔納（Kevin Datana）自從五年前在訓練中認識以來，一直是科里安德（Cori）的搭檔。在那段時間裡，他與她保持著公事上的距離。兩人剛剛完成一次漫長的任務回來，最後，一切都到了緊要關頭——他必須坦白。但他可以嗎？或者他是否已經當朋友當了太久，再也沒辦法往前一步？他有一天的時間出去一探究竟。有趣的配角會幫助或阻礙他——成功或失敗，他的命運掌握在你的手中。


［來自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/totootfz.shtml]仁愛檔案[/url]］
